component.name: mcp-server-subreg
component.summary: MCP server for the Subreg.cz domain registrar

description.p: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing the Subreg.cz domain registrar SOAP API as tools for an LLM agent, built on fastmcp and python3-subreg-client.

Tools cover domain availability/info/listing, pricelists, account credit, DNS zone lookups, contacts, and order status, read-only by default, plus domain registration/renewal/deletion, DNS record writes, contact writes, and credit adjustments, gated behind SUBREG_READONLY=false. Login credentials are read once from the environment at startup and are never tool parameters.
